title: #72 Building Effects
prompt: Do you think the design of buildings affects, positively or negatively, where people live and work?

promptSegments.text: Do you think the design of buildings affects, positively or negatively, where people live and work?

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Good building design improves living areas by creating safe and happy homes, which helps build a strong community.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Good building design improves living areas by creating safe and happy homes, which helps build a strong community.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Conversely, poor building design can cause negative problems, such as making areas difficult to navigate and harming the environment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Conversely, poor building design can cause negative problems, such as making areas difficult to navigate and harming the environment.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Building design can make living areas very convenient.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Building design can make living areas very convenient.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Building design can create problems for the community.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Building design can create problems for the community.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Good building design improves the quality of life by making daily routines easier, such as having small shops and offices close to homes, which supports a strong local community.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Good building design improves the quality of life by making daily routines easier, such as having small shops and offices close to homes, which supports a strong local community.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Conversely, poor building design can cause problems because badly planned structures often lack necessary services, forcing workers to spend time and money on commuting.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Conversely, poor building design can cause problems because badly planned structures often lack necessary services, forcing workers to spend time and money on commuting.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses how good design can create convenient places for people to live, focusing on the benefit of local services.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph discusses how good design can create convenient places for people to live, focusing on the benefit of local services.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph argues that poor design is a disadvantage because it separates residential areas from job centers, forcing people to travel long distances.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph argues that poor design is a disadvantage because it separates residential areas from job centers, forcing people to travel long distances.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
